_comment: Between-level cinematics (scripts/interlude_cinematic.gd, docs/CUTSCENE_SCRIPTS.md): a split-screen call over the MP3 between Miro (inside the tower) and his brother. Keyed by the floor just finished. VOICE and NIRO lines use niro_<hash> clips over the remote; MIRO lines use miro_<hash>. named=false hides Niro's face until his name is revealed on Level 3. hunted_first replaces the first line when Campaign.reputation() is HUNTED (the only branch: MISSING keeps the written line).
opening_pa: Lights out. Cells sealed. Report every cough, including your own.

1.title: LEVEL 2
lines: You have the remote. Keep it close, and keep quiet.
Who is this? How do you know my name?
Someone who wants you out alive. Go down. The coughing started on the floors below, and it is spreading.
Someone is guiding me down. I should find out why.
1.hunted_first: You have the remote. Keep it close, and keep your hands clean.

2.title: LEVEL 3
lines: If you go any lower, I can't protect you.
From what they keep in the records. The sickness did not start in the cells, Miro.
Find the personnel records on three. You will understand why I kept calling you back.
2.hunted_first: You are leaving Keepers behind you. If you go any lower, I can't protect you.

3.title: LEVEL 4
lines: Now you know my name. Please, stop at the records.
You kept me in here, Niro. Was I sick too?
Not over a remote. Read what the ward kept, then decide what I am to you.
Brother. The word feels true, and I hate that.
3.hunted_first: I watched every Keeper you dropped. Now you know my name. Please, stop at the records.

4.title: LEVEL 5
lines: Don't come down here, Miro. Please.
The seals, the supports. Everything rests on the floor below.
Everything rests on what we kept down there. I never lied about the sickness. I only never told you whose it was.
4.hunted_first: You are making this harder, Miro. Don't come down here. Please.

hunt_thoughts: They are looking for me upstairs. They're too late.
They know my cell is empty. From here on, nobody is idle.
